why: A range slider is not text entry; treating it as one swallows Escape and the hotkeys while the volume slider is focused.
killedBy: consumesKey a range input (the volume slider) keeps only the keys that operate it
createInputController — focus does not steal the tank still drives after the player has used a HUD control
isTextEntry is false for a range, checkbox or button-typed input, a button, a select, and a plain div
